sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 35B A3B: Unified Vision-Language MoE Reasoning Model Qwen3.5 35B A3B is a multimodal mixture-of-experts foundation model from Alibaba's Qwen team, featuring a hybrid Gated DeltaNet and sparse MoE architecture.
